summary: Honest, anti-sycophancy reference guide covering 12 tools from the user's YouTube production workflows: Groq API, Groq Whisper, Python, Mixkit, Supadata, TubeBuddy, Unminus, YouTube Analytics MCP, youtube-transcript-api, yt-dlp, spy_competitor.py, and Spotter Studio. Each entry covers what the tool is, where it lives (download/cloud/website), real limitations and complaints, pricing, and specific use cases for a long-form YouTube content creator. Includes a quick-reference table mapping every tool to its type and access location.
